Notification under the Section 184 of the Urban Council Ordinance (Chapter 255) and the ProvincialCouncil (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989

I, Maheepala Herath, Chief Minister and Minister of Law and Order, Finance and Planning, Local Government, Health andIndigenous Medicine, Women Affairs, Co-operatives, Trade and Food, Transport and Estate Welfare, Environment, News,Housing and Construction of the Sabaragamuwa Province, appointed a retired Judicial Officer, as a single person tribunalof inquiry as per the powers vested in me by the provisions of Section 184 (1) of the Urban Council Ordinance (Chapter255) to inquire and submit me a report whether he has committed an offence based on the matters under Section 184 (1)of the Urban Council Ordinance (Chapter 255), regarding the functions of the Chairman of the Embilipitiya Urban Councilof the Ratnapura District, Ven. Vewelduwe Gnanaprabha Thero and now I have received the above mentioned inquiryreport. Having deeply studying the allegations, evidences and documents against Ven. Vewelduwe Gnanaprabha Thero, Iam satisfied that there are enough evidences to prove the said Ven. Vewelduwe Gnanaprabha Thero has committed one ormore offences specified under section 184 (1) of the Urban Council Ordinance. Hence, I do hereby expel Ven. VewelduweGnanaprabha Thero, Chairman of the Embilipitiya Urban Council from the post of Chairman of the said Urban Counciland from its membership by virtue of powers vested in me under the provisions of Section 184 (1B) (B) of the UrbanCouncil Ordinance (Chapter 255)

MAHEEPALA HERATH,Chief Minister and Minister of Law and Order, Finance and Planning,Local Government, Health and Indigenous Medicine, Women Affairs,Co-operatives, Trade and Food, Transport and Estate Welfare, Environment,News, Housing and Construction of the Sabaragamuwa Province.
Chief Ministry of the Sabararagamuwa Provincial Council,New Town,Ratnapura,On this 28th of July, 2015.
